integrity: The proof reduces the composition to a fair cut-bit string, couples adjacent fixed-weight slices by adding one uniformly chosen cut, and decomposes the mixed covariance into exact single-coordinate longest-run decrements. A deterministic unique-longest-run bound and a union bound give the quantitative rate; exhaustive finite enumeration independently replays the identities.
scientific_limitations: The quantitative covariance estimate is an upper bound; no matching lower asymptotic is claimed.
The theorem is for unrestricted uniform compositions, equivalently fair independent cut bits.
Exact conditional longest-run formulas predate this result; the new claim concerns the monotone coupling, influence identity, and rigorous decorrelation rate.
title: Rigorous decorrelation of part count and maximum in uniform compositions
